author: Dr15Jones
body:
#### PR description:

- For data consumed from Run and LuminosityBlock, now explicitly say from which callback transition the data will be requested.
- Special handling was required for L1GtUtilsHelper as same token was being used for both beginRun and Event transitions.

At the moment the framework does not use this information, but we will be moving to enforcing this.

#### PR validation:

Code compiles.

resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2505
title: Add edm::Transition to  consumes calls
